detail: motor mg90-c, board dev-v006-2A-D, state free
Motor leads on the board's motor connector, the bar OFF the pinion, the rotor free, no meter.
This plan pulses 7.4 V at 100 % into the motor from rest, over its rated 5.0 V, and may change its brushes for good.
4 ms pulse: coast EMF at the cut 1.64 V
6 ms pulse: coast EMF at the cut 2.02 V
8 ms pulse: coast EMF at the cut 2.32 V
